title: Ask AI for a random number. It's not random. 🤖

beats.say: Ask an AI to pick a random number from one to a hundred.
Researchers at Gramener found they almost never pick repeated digits like eleven or ninety nine.
But numbers ending in seven? Constantly.

beats.sub: one theory: it copies how people "sound random"
beats.say: One theory: it learned from humans, and humans think seven sounds random too.
Follow for more things the algorithm did.
